composition: GenericCreationFrontendHostV1 owns RuntimeCreationFlowAdapterV1 while the caller invokes run_frontend_v1 with runtime_services(); complete() converts only an actual generic StartGame result into a typed launch plan.

launch_evidence.same_character_state: shared pointer address and shared control block must match the caller owner
launch_evidence.selected_save: explicit save path and exact selected slot are retained
launch_evidence.start: requires generic_gameplay_started plus a start_delivered generic receipt
launch_evidence.native_authority: does not create or satisfy FrontendProfileLoanV1, native action receipts, or InitPost

provider_requirements: empty-slot selector that creates the exact request and save path
selected-slot assignment provider for the same source application
StartGame provider consuming the caller's unchanged shared CharacterState
test_command: cmake --build .local-inputs/frontend-feature-build --target frontend_runtime_v1 generic_creation_host_v1_tests runtime_creation_flow_adapter_v1_tests frontend_runtime_v1_tests -j6 && ctest --test-dir .local-inputs/frontend-feature-build -R '^(generic_creation_host_v1_tests|runtime_creation_flow_adapter_v1_tests|frontend_runtime_v1_tests)$' --output-on-failure
limits: No GUI run and no root main/CMake, core, native V60, player, save, or world provider was created or changed. Root still supplies the real service providers and protected callsite.
